directives.directive_title: Every Website = Language-Aware by Design (Multilingual-First Architecture & Language Completeness Gate)
directives.author: User (Tier-1 Human Directive)
verification_criteria: All expected language routes built with deterministic URLs
100% self-canonical tags across all localized pages
Full reciprocal hreflang alternate links with x-default
Zero mismatch across Canonical, Sitemap, Hreflang, and Internal Links
Anti-thin content gate: natural queries and deep body localization verified
Language Completeness Gate: Expected languages === Generated languages
